mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id as userId, stability, dominant_emotion as dominantEmotion, range_label as rangeLabel, created_at as createdAt, updated_at as updatedAt, emotion_bars as emotionBarsRaw, weekly_flow as weeklyFlowRaw, keywords as keywordsRaw FROM emotion_reports WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
